execute.sql:
CREATE TABLE "public"."order_item_toppings" (
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "orderItemId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "toppingId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "toppingName" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "toppingPrice" numeric(12,2) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."order_items" (
  "basePrice" numeric(12,2) NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "orderId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "productId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "productName" character varying(150) NOT NULL,
  "quantity" int4 NOT NULL,
  "size" character varying(10) NOT NULL,
  "sizeExtraPrice" numeric(12,2) NOT NULL,
  "subtotal" numeric(12,2) NOT NULL,
  "unitPrice" numeric(12,2) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."orders" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "discountAmount" numeric(12,2) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "note" character varying(500),
  "orderCode" character varying(50) NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "subtotal" numeric(12,2) NOT NULL,
  "totalAmount" numeric(12,2) NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "orders_status_check_87a85c50" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'PAID', 'PAYMENT_FAILED', 'PREPARING', 'READY', 'COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."payments" (
  "amount" numeric(12,2) NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "failureReason" character varying(500),
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "method" text NOT NULL,
  "orderId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "paidAt" timestamptz,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "transactionCode" character varying(100),
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "payments_method_check_48f07f79" CHECK ("method" IN ('E_WALLET', 'CARD')),
  CONSTRAINT "payments_status_check_f32a67f1" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'SUCCESS', 'FAILED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."product_sizes" (
  "extraPrice" numeric(12,2) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "productId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "size" character varying(10) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."product_toppings" (
  "productId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "toppingId" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("productId", "toppingId")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."products" (
  "basePrice" numeric(12,2) NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "imageUrl" character varying(500),
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "name" character varying(150) NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."toppings" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "name" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "price" numeric(12,2) NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."users" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" character varying(255) NOT NULL,
  "fullName" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "passwordHash" character varying(255) NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
